crossRefs.note: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people…
But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt…

translations.web: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”
translations.bsb: Now get to work. You will be given no straw, yet you must deliver the full quota of bricks.”
translations.kjv: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
translations.asv: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the number of bricks.
